agent.problem: The statement being judged also uses Ezekiel 8:5: God tells Ezekiel to lift his eyes north, and he sees the idol of jealousy. Citing only 8:6 leaves part of the statement without its reference. The card should cite Ezekiel 8:5-6, or the verse 5 setup should be moved to an earlier story card.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower. A choice card cites only the verses of its right answer.

agent.problem: "Inside that hidden room" and "all those engravings" point back to cards 11-12, which are no longer on screen. The question also never names Ezekiel or freshly establishes the scene, so it is not self-contained.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

agent.problem: This story card only repeats the already-answered facts that the men have their backs to the LORD's house and are bowing to the sun, then adds the ATM joke. It introduces no new moment or detail from the vision, making it a recap card rather than a card that moves the passage forward.

rule.text: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. No recap cards.

human.question: When the last story card is only the story-isn't-over line and tells no verse, what goes in its "verses" field: the passage's last verse, the whole passage, or something else?
